ba3486cdae700af442d0f7f87274612dbcd3a5ef.summary: This page is an archive index for the UAC-0226 category on the Synaptic Security Blog. It lists two post teasers: a June 2026 post on how UAC-0226 tooling evolved from WinRAR ADS to reflective loading, involving the GIFTEDCROOK loader, and an April 2026 post on breaking a GIFTEDCROOK stealer. The page contains only titles, dates and short excerpts, with no threat analysis of its own, so it is an index rather than a threat report.
